item.travelersbackpack.tool_swapper_upgr: Swaps the tool in your hand for a suitable one from the backpack when it can't mine the block
item.travelersbackpack.iron_stack_upgrad: Multiplies the stack size in the backpack storage by 2 (up to 128 per slot)
item.travelersbackpack.gold_stack_upgrad: Multiplies the stack size in the backpack storage by 4 (up to 256 per slot)
item.travelersbackpack.diamond_stack_upg: Multiplies the stack size in the backpack storage by 8 (up to 512 per slot)
